mas: row-vectorised NumPy; identical paths to the loop version
scope: full LJSpeech training; fixed-crop probe on 8 training utterances; not held-out
model:
VITSModel(
  (text_encoder): TextEncoder(
    (token_embedding): Embedding(76, 192, padding_idx=0)
    (position_embedding): Embedding(512, 192)
    (transformer): TransformerEncoder(
      (layers): ModuleList(
        (0-5): 6 x TransformerEncoderLayer(
          (self_attn): MultiheadAttention(
            (out_proj): NonDynamicallyQuantizableLinear(in_features=192, out_features=192, bias=True)
          )
          (linear1): Linear(in_features=192, out_features=768, bias=True)
          (dropout): Dropout(p=0.1, inplace=False)
          (linear2): Linear(in_features=768, out_features=192, bias=True)
          (norm1): LayerNorm((192,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
          (norm2): LayerNorm((192,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
          (dropout1): Dropout(p=0.1, inplace=False)
          (dropout2): Dropout(p=0.1, inplace=False)
        )
      )
    )
    (statistics_projection): Linear(in_features=192, out_features=384, bias=True)
  )
  (posterior_encoder): PosteriorEncoder(
    (input_projection): Conv1d(513, 192, kernel_size=(1,), stride=(1,))
    (conv1): Conv1d(192, 192, kernel_size=(5,), stride=(1,), padding=(2,))
    (conv2): Conv1d(192, 192, kernel_size=(5,), stride=(1,), padding=(4,), dilation=(2,))
    (conv3): Conv1d(192, 192, kernel_size=(5,), stride=(1,), padding=(8,), dilation=(4,))
    (conv4): Conv1d(192, 192, kernel_size=(5,), stride=(1,), padding=(16,), dilation=(8,))
    (activation): GELU(approximate='none')
    (dropout): Dropout(p=0.1, inplace=False)
    (mean_projection): Conv1d(192, 192, kernel_size=(1,), stride=(1,))
    (log_scale_projection): Conv1d(192, 192, kernel_size=(1,), stride=(1,))
  )
  (flow): ResidualCouplingBlock(
    (coupling_layers): ModuleList(
      (0-3): 4 x ResidualCouplingLayer(
        (coupling_network): CouplingNetwork(
          (input_projection): Conv1d(96, 192, kernel_size=(1,), stride=(1,))
          (residual_layers): ModuleList(
            (0-3): 4 x ResidualConvLayer(
              (conv): Conv1d(192, 192, kernel_size=(5,), stride=(1,), padding=(2,))
              (norm): ChannelLayerNorm(
                (norm): LayerNorm((192,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
              )
              (dropout): Dropout(p=0.0, inplace=False)
            )
          )
          (output_projection): Conv1d(192, 96, kernel_size=(1,), stride=(1,))
        )
      )
    )
  )
  (duration_predictor): DurationPredictor(
    (conv_block_1): DurationConvBlock(
      (conv): Conv1d(192, 256, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
      (norm): ChannelLayerNorm(
        (norm): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
      )
      (dropout): Dropout(p=0.5, inplace=False)
    )
    (conv_block_2): DurationConvBlock(
      (conv): Conv1d(256, 256, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
      (norm): ChannelLayerNorm(
        (norm): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
      )
      (dropout): Dropout(p=0.5, inplace=False)
    )
    (output_projection): Conv1d(256, 1, kernel_size=(1,), stride=(1,))
  )
  (decoder): Decoder(
    (input_projection): Conv1d(192, 512, kernel_size=(7,), stride=(1,), padding=(3,))
    (upsample1): ConvTranspose1d(512, 256, kernel_size=(16,), stride=(8,), padding=(4,))
    (resblock1): ResBlock(
      (layers): ModuleList(
        (0): Sequential(
          (0): LeakyReLU(negative_slope=0.1)
          (1): Conv1d(256, 256, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
          (2): LeakyReLU(negative_slope=0.1)
          (3): Conv1d(256, 256, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
        )
        (1): Sequential(
          (0): LeakyReLU(negative_slope=0.1)
          (1): Conv1d(256, 256, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(3,), dilation=(3,))
          (2): LeakyReLU(negative_slope=0.1)
          (3): Conv1d(256, 256, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
        )
        (2): Sequential(
          (0): LeakyReLU(negative_slope=0.1)
          (1): Conv1d(256, 256, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(5,), dilation=(5,))
          (2): LeakyReLU(negative_slope=0.1)
          (3): Conv1d(256, 256, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
        )
      )
    )
    (upsample2): ConvTranspose1d(256, 128, kernel_size=(16,), stride=(8,), padding=(4,))
    (resblock2): ResBlock(
      (layers): ModuleList(
        (0): Sequential(
          (0): LeakyReLU(negative_slope=0.1)
          (1): Conv1d(128, 128, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
          (2): LeakyReLU(negative_slope=0.1)
          (3): Conv1d(128, 128, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
        )
        (1): Sequential(
          (0): LeakyReLU(negative_slope=0.1)
          (1): Conv1d(128, 128, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(3,), dilation=(3,))
          (2): LeakyReLU(negative_slope=0.1)
          (3): Conv1d(128, 128, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
        )
        (2): Sequential(
          (0): LeakyReLU(negative_slope=0.1)
          (1): Conv1d(128, 128, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(5,), dilation=(5,))
          (2): LeakyReLU(negative_slope=0.1)
          (3): Conv1d(128, 128, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
        )
      )
    )
    (upsample3): ConvTranspose1d(128, 64, kernel_size=(4,), stride=(2,), padding=(1,))
    (resblock3): ResBlock(
      (layers): ModuleList(
        (0): Sequential(
          (0): LeakyReLU(negative_slope=0.1)
          (1): Conv1d(64, 64, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
          (2): LeakyReLU(negative_slope=0.1)
          (3): Conv1d(64, 64, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
        )
        (1): Sequential(
          (0): LeakyReLU(negative_slope=0.1)
          (1): Conv1d(64, 64, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(3,), dilation=(3,))
          (2): LeakyReLU(negative_slope=0.1)
          (3): Conv1d(64, 64, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
        )
        (2): Sequential(
          (0): LeakyReLU(negative_slope=0.1)
          (1): Conv1d(64, 64, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(5,), dilation=(5,))
          (2): LeakyReLU(negative_slope=0.1)
          (3): Conv1d(64, 64, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
        )
      )
    )
    (upsample4): ConvTranspose1d(64, 32, kernel_size=(4,), stride=(2,), padding=(1,))
    (resblock4): ResBlock(
      (layers): ModuleList(
        (0): Sequential(
          (0): LeakyReLU(negative_slope=0.1)
          (1): Conv1d(32, 32, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
          (2): LeakyReLU(negative_slope=0.1)
          (3): Conv1d(32, 32, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
        )
        (1): Sequential(
          (0): LeakyReLU(negative_slope=0.1)
          (1): Conv1d(32, 32, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(3,), dilation=(3,))
          (2): LeakyReLU(negative_slope=0.1)
          (3): Conv1d(32, 32, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
        )
        (2): Sequential(
          (0): LeakyReLU(negative_slope=0.1)
          (1): Conv1d(32, 32, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(5,), dilation=(5,))
          (2): LeakyReLU(negative_slope=0.1)
          (3): Conv1d(32, 32, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
        )
      )
    )
    (output_projection): Conv1d(32, 1, kernel_size=(7,), stride=(1,), padding=(3,))
  )
)
